integrity: Finite rational computations support but do not replace the all-size analytic Green-function and Fourier proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, uniform periodic one-dimensional consistent-mass linear finite elements for the unit-diffusivity heat equation only; no general variable-mesh or floating-point guarantee. Related older cyclic monotonicity literature may not be exhaustively indexed.
title: Exact periodic finite-element Crank–Nicolson positivity and a decreasing mesh-size threshold
